description: Read how your workspace takes offers and counter-offers from buyers: whether offers are on, your public handle, the rounds, concession and expiry limits, the products open to offers with their list and floor prices, the last 30 days' negotiations, and the public URLs a buyer's agent uses. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: get_offer_settings
